comparison.metric: mean absolute RGB pixel delta on normalized 1200x675 images, channel range 0-255
comparison.normalization: Dropped the rightmost one-pixel PDF raster rounding column (1601x900 to 1600x900), then resized with Pillow LANCZOS to the approved 1200x675 preview size.

known_renderer_differences: LibreOffice PDF rasterization and CairoSVG preview rendering use different anti-aliasing and font rasterization/metrics.
The 1601x900 PDF PNG dimensions require the documented one-pixel width normalization before comparison.
The verdict is threshold-based and does not claim byte-identical or pixel-identical output.

LibreOffice grows an autofit text box about its centre where PowerPoint grows it to the right, so a left-aligned heading wider than its measured box shifts horizontally in the LibreOffice column. This is the largest single contributor to the slide-1 delta.
